def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Remove inserted 5x5 tiles which contain 9 markers, when they are isolated patch copies.
    # Demo shows central 5x5 pattern erased; at rows 6-9 cols 5-9 (0-based), pattern is one anomalous object.
    # Specifically remove 3s/9s in tile at (6,5) through (9,8), restoring zero background.
    # Generalize: any 5x5/partial patch occupying a blank region, carrying 9s, remove it.
    R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    for r0 in range(R):
      for c0 in range(C):
        # candidate 5x5, require border all zero around and patch contains color3
        r1=min(R,r0+5); c1=min(C,c0+5)
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)]
        if len(cells)<15: continue
        # use 5x5 tile positioned in a zero rectangle? demo target r6:10 c5:9 contains 3/9 and surrounding mostly zero.
    return out
PY
